tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by five different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
OpenAI is being sued by parents over ChatGPT advising an epilepsy medication taper that led to their daughter's death, confirmed by Quartz.
Circuit Mind raised 25M to launch an artificial intelligence tool that cuts design time by 90 percent and reduces costs by 25 percent, confirmed by SiliconANGLE.
Apple's Creator Studio gets artificial intelligence tools in November, free for new Mac and iPad buyers, confirmed by Yahoo Tech.
Verisk expands insurance intelligence access via Amazon Quick and Microsoft Copilot integrations, confirmed by Quiver Quantitative.
Anthropic files for an initial public offering as tech indices rise and the artificial intelligence sector surges, reported by The Jerusalem Post.
Free every hour.
